headline: 2 cars left and none arrived between 1 Sep and 2 Sep; the camera could not see for 14 min 15 s.

bullets.text: 2 cars parked on 1 Sep were gone on 2 Sep.
Most visitors near one parked car: 6 came close (4 cars and 2 trucks) between 10:51 and 11:51.
In total 151 cars, 6 people and 5 trucks moved through the view; 84 tracks were parked vehicles.
Busiest route: 23 vehicles went left to right across the lower middle.
Busiest moment: 3 vehicles on screen at 18:25.

honesty: The camera could not see for 14 min 15 s in total, in 19 stretches (7 min 36 s picture froze, 5 min 25 s blurry picture, 68 s view blocked and 6 s no picture); the longest was 18:09 to 26:07. Anything that happened then is unknown.
2 parked cars could not be compared between the two days (1 because: a vehicle stood on this spot for 3 s in a row on day 20260901 but not long enough to count as parked: can't tell).
Counts come from an automatic detector; one person or car can be counted twice if it was lost and found again.
68 more tracks hardly moved (less than their own width) and are not counted as going by.
'Came close' only means near: 18 of the 40 parked vehicles checked had someone or something close by, which says nothing about who did anything.
"2 cars parked on 1 Sep were gone on 2 Sep" at 02:00 falls in a stretch when the camera could not see well (picture froze), so treat it with care.
"Busiest moment" at 18:25 falls in a stretch when the camera could not see well (view blocked), so treat it with care.
